description: Change an order: pass order_id and at least one of status, total_amount, currency, metadata and billing_contact_id; null clears the billing contact. An order that has left draft cannot return to it. Needs a claimed Last Price credential. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

billing_contact_id.description: The contact to bill, one of the order's customer; null clears it.

metadata.description: Anything worth keeping with the record.

order_id.description: The order: its id, as list_orders shows it.

name: update_order
